data.Name: Drogon Reservoir
data.Description: Drogon oil and gas field, Norwegian Continental Shelf. Jurassic sandstone reservoir (Valysar formation — Volantis/Therys/Volon members). 7 fault-bounded segments.

data.Description: 3-step FMU workflow: parameter generation → RMS geomodel (facies + petrophysics) → volume aggregation to P10/P50/P90. DecisionExample workflow, 3 realisations.

data.Name: Porosity and cementation uncertainty
data.Description: Porosity variation in Valysar fluvial deposits (Floodplain ~0.10, Channel ~0.28, Crevasse ~0.21) drives volume and recovery factor uncertainty across 7 segments.

data.Name: Fault transmissibility and reservoir compartmentalization
data.Description: Fault transmissibility may compartmentalize reservoir, restricting pressure communication and drainage. Could require additional infill wells beyond the 12-well plan (50–150 MUSD impact).

MitigationActions: RFT pressure analysis from appraisal wells

data.Name: Drogon - Subsurface Risk Assessment (SRA) DG1
data.Description: P50 first oil June 2028, P90 March 2029. Key drivers: FPSO drydock slot, subsea template fabrication.

data.Name: Drogon - Cost Risk Assessment (CRA) DG1
data.Description: P50 CAPEX 8,200 MNOK, P90 10,100 MNOK. Main drivers: drilling duration (12–16 wells), FPSO water treatment.

data.Name: Drogon - Plan for Development and Operation (PDO) Draft
data.Description: Field description, subsea tieback to FPSO, well planning, environmental/regulatory alignment.

data.Name: Drogon DG1 - Evidence Package
data.Description: Complete evidence bundle for Identify & Assess decision gate

data.Name: Drogon DG1 - Identify & Assess
data.Description: DG1 volume assessment of the Valysar formation, Drogon field. P10/P50/P90 oil & gas estimates across 7 segments.
data.DecisionSummary: Assess Valysar in-place volumes and recommend proceed/no-go for DG2. NPV(10%) 280 MUSD, IRR 12%, CAPEX 6,500 MNOK, break-even 55 USD/bbl.

Alternatives.Name: Proceed to DG2 - full 7-segment development
Alternatives.Rationale: Recommended: highest expected value, leverages full reservoir extent

Alternatives.Name: Reduced scope - CentralHorst + CentralSouth only
Alternatives.Rationale: Lower risk but sacrifices 40% of recoverable volume

Alternatives.Name: Defer - acquire more appraisal data
Alternatives.Rationale: Fallback if porosity/fault risk unacceptable at current maturity
